# v0.4.1 簡明用語澄清候選／Plain-wording clarification candidate

## 繁體中文

### 目的與範圍

依使用者同意，在 [wf-writing](../../contracts/workflow.md#wf-writing) 補明如何減少不必要的行話、縮寫、中英混用及名詞連用，同時按讀者解釋必要術語、保留精確技術細節。原文已有讀者、直接句型、一致術語、首次解釋及精度要求；本包只將常見難讀寫法具體化，不建立新的詞彙禁令、認證或 gate。依 [版本方式](../../CHANGELOG.md) 準備不改變義務的 patch `v0.4.1`；若後續實際差異改變義務，須重評版本與範圍，不能只以本段自稱澄清。

五檔範圍：workflow 只插入完整句子；CHANGELOG 與 source-map 只加新候選記錄；新增[非權威雙語例子](../companion/plain-writing-examples.md)及本準備紀錄。其餘三契約、#23 一次性環境接受例外、LICENSE、完整 notices、全部舊字及歷史發行紀錄保持原 bytes／行序／mode。原 107 單位與先前來源不倒寫；例子為本包假設情境，不是執行結果。

### 驗收與限制

核對固定基準 `4c8d35ad7c8e9d6a7c47331e5bd93eea2b45c535` 的全部 26 檔，確定性確認每條舊行 raw bytes／順序與 mode／type 保留；比較方法另以合法插入正例及刪字、換字、換序等破壞負例驗證。新清冊預期為 27 份 Markdown 加 LICENSE，共 28 檔，逐檔查 raw bytes、mode、引用閉包與原 anchors；檢查 whitespace 及有界敏感資料。查核程式與執行紀錄留 Git 外，Core 不新增 validator 或 runtime。

獨立文件審查須閱讀完整差異與相鄰契約，核對新增句子只是既有要求的具體化、例子保留重要資訊、雙語一致、歷史及版本角色正確，並記安全差異掃描適用性、結果與限制。實際驗證及 review 另綁定候選身分；本紀錄不自宣通過。若建立 PR，新 HEAD 仍須完整 Merge Review。CI 未配置／未執行不列 Passed。

英文技術文仍依 ASD-STE100 原則編寫，尚未完成完整符合性驗證；繁中採簡明原則調適，不宣稱符合英文受控語言標準。例子不證明模型、runtime、控制或 consumer 遵循，也不承諾品質、成本或 token 改善。

### 發布與下游

本紀錄只準備候選，不證明 commit、PR、合併、tag／Release 或安裝已完成。各項公開操作另核精確目標、內容、中繼資料、目的地、有效授權及必要前置；既有公開歷史與 tag 不覆寫。正式發布後仍以 annotated tag object、解析後完整 commit 與 GitHub Release metadata 判定 publication，不回填此準備紀錄。

Core 與 Codex 各自管理版本，沒有必須同時發行的要求。若要正式發布本包，Core 使用自己的 patch；Codex 後續採用時另查版本、固定新 Core revision，更新清冊／digest／引用閉包並驗證自己的文件技能，再決定其版本及安裝。本次不改 consumer、既有安裝或啟動設定；單純準備 Core 文件不需要重啟 Codex。Grok 不啟動、相容性未驗證。

## English

### Purpose, scope and acceptance

Under the user's approval, clarify wf-writing's existing reader, terminology and precision requirements. Reduce unnecessary jargon, abbreviations, mixed-language wording and noun sequences. Keep precise technical detail and explain necessary terms when the reader needs it. Add no word prohibition, certification or gate. Prepare patch v0.4.1 under CHANGELOG for clarification without changed duties. Reassess version and scope if the actual change adds duties; this record alone cannot classify it.

The five-file scope adds complete sentences to workflow, entries to CHANGELOG and source-map, and two new documents: optional bilingual examples and this record. Preserve every earlier word/raw line/order/mode, the other three contracts including the #23 environment exception, LICENSE, complete notices and historical releases. Preserve original107 provenance. Examples are hypothetical, not execution results.

Verify all 26 baseline files at `4c8d35ad7c8e9d6a7c47331e5bd93eea2b45c535`, with deterministic raw-line preservation and mode/type checks. Validate the comparator with permitted-insertion positives and corruption negatives. Check the new 28-file inventory (27 Markdown plus LICENSE), raw bytes, modes, references, old anchors, whitespace and bounded privacy. Keep checkers and execution records outside Git; add no Core validator or runtime.

Independent document review covers the full diff and adjacent contracts, existing-duty equivalence, information retained by examples, bilingual consistency, historical/version roles and security-scan applicability. Bind actual verification and review separately to the candidate; this record supplies no PASS. A later PR head still needs complete Merge Review. Missing or unrun CI is not passed. English uses ASD-STE100 principles; full conformance is unverified. Chinese adapts plain-writing principles without an English controlled-language conformance claim. Examples qualify no model, runtime, technical control or consumer, and establish no quality, cost or token saving.

### Publication and adoption

Preparation proves no commit, PR, merge, tag/Release or installation. Recheck each public operation's exact target, payload, metadata, destination, authority and prerequisites. Overwrite no public history or tag. Publication truth comes from the annotated tag object, resolved full commit and GitHub Release metadata; do not backfill this preparation record after publication.

Core and Codex manage versions independently; simultaneous releases are not required. Formal publication would use Core's patch version. Later Codex adoption checks its own version, fixes the new Core revision, updates inventory/digests/reference closure and verifies its document skills before deciding its version and installation. This work changes no consumer, existing installation or startup setting. Preparing Core documents alone needs no Codex restart. Grok remains deferred with unverified compatibility.
